results.title: Lyon - Wikipedia
results.content: Lyon[c] (Franco-Provençal: Liyon; formerly Lyons in English) [d] is a city in France. It is located at the confluence of the rivers Rhône and Saône, to the northwest of the French Alps, 391 km (243 mi) southeast of Paris, 278 km (173 mi) north of Marseille, and 113 km (70 mi) southwest of Geneva, Switzerland. results.content: Lyon, once known as ‘Lugdunum’ during Roman times, wears its historical heart on its sleeve. Its well-preserved ancient Roman architecture has earned it a UNESCO World Heritage site tag. (A surprising fact about France is that Lyon was more important than Paris during Roman times!)
